changelog: **The zoom scale now reaches the rule "Zoom to now" is asked to obey.** With the rule in 1.0.90.0 - a third of the view for the programme on air, and never less than about half an hour of schedule on screen - a short programme asks for about 1500 pixels an hour, and the slider stopped at 1200. So the ask fell off the end of the scale, the slider pinned at its maximum, and a four-minute trailer still got the most zoomed-in view the page had. The scale runs to 2400 now and the wanted zoom is reachable. The three hand-written copies of the slider's bounds - the store, the slider itself and the clamp - are one exported pair.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
